_comment: Hand-written store release notes for 10.7.1, in both listing languages. tool/gen_changelog.py prefers this file over anything it can derive from the commits, then runs it through the same per-store platform gate as every other source — so keep every line free of operating-system, device and store names. One line per bullet; the leading bullet character is added when the note is written. Keep it short: the Play note is capped at 480 characters including the bullets.
en:
Refreshed store pictures that show the app as it looks today
Smaller fixes and improvements
de:
Neue Store-Bilder, die die App so zeigen, wie sie heute aussieht
Kleinere Korrekturen und Verbesserungen
